description: The waiting time for XON or CTS = ON has expired.
remedy: The communication partner has a fault, is too slow or is offline. Check the communication partner or change the parameters, if necessary.

description: "Hardware RTS always ON": Send job canceled due to change from DSR = ON to OFF
remedy: Check the communication partner. Make sure that DSR is ON for the entire duration of transmission.

description: Frame aborted: Send buffer overflow / send frame too long
remedy: In the user program call the instruction more often or configure a communication with data flow control.

description: Frame aborted: Parity error
remedy: Check the connection line of the communication partners, or verify that the same data transmission rate, parity and stop bit number are configured for both devices.

description: Frame aborted: Character frame error
remedy: Check the settings for start bit, data bits, parity bit, data transmission rate, and stop bit(s).

description: Frame aborted: Character overflow error
remedy: Check the number of data in the frame of the communication partner.

description: Frame aborted: Maximum frame length reached
remedy:
Select a shorter frame length at the communication partner.
The following are valid (depending on the module): 1 to 1024/2048/4096 (bytes)

description: The slave does not respond within the set time
remedy: Check the data transmission rate, parity and wiring of the slave.

description: The slave does not respond within the time set by Blocked_Proc_Timeout.
remedy:
Check the setting for Blocked_Proc_Timeout.
Check if the module has been configured with the Modbus_Comm_Load instruction. The module may possibly need to be reconfigured using Modbus_Comm_Load after a pull/plug or after voltage recovery.

description: The interface is busy with an ongoing request.
remedy: Repeat the command later. Make sure that there are no commands still running before you start a new one.

remedy: Select an even number of bytes.

remedy:
Select a suitable parameter number (PARAM).
The following numbers are valid: 0-2047

category: Error message codes of the special functions

remedy:
Select a suitable value for the CRC calculation.
The following are valid: deactivated or activated.
Check whether the module addressed supports CRC calculation.

Check whether the module addressed supports the generation of diagnostic interrupts.

None (1)
Even (2)

Space (5)
Any (6)

7 (2)
8 (1)

remedy: Select a valid data flow control for the module (FLOWCTRL).

remedy:
Select suitable values for XON (XONCHAR) and XOFF (XOFFCHAR).
Valid range of values: 0...255

category: Error message codes of the "Port configuration"
description: Invalid operating mode
remedy:
Valid operating modes are:
Full duplex (RS232) (0)
Full duplex (RS422) four-wire mode (point-to-point) (1) / (CM PtP (ET 200SP))
Full duplex (RS422) four-wire mode (multipoint master) (2)/ (CM PtP (ET 200SP))
Full duplex (RS 422) four-wire mode (multipoint slave) (3)
Half duplex (RS485) two-wire mode. (4)

category: Error message codes of the "Port configuration"
description: Invalid receive line initial state
remedy:
Valid initial states are:
"No" default setting (0)
Signal R(A)=5 V, signal R(B)=0 V (break detection) (1):
Can only be selected with: "Full duplex (RS422) four-wire mode (point-to-point connection)" and "Full duplex (RS422) four-wire mode (multipoint slave)".
Signal R(A)=0 V, signal R(B)=5 V (2): This default setting corresponds to the idle state (no active send operation).

category: Error message codes of the "Port configuration"
description: Invalid value for "Break detection"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Break detection". The following are valid:
Break detection deactivated (0)
Break detection activated (1).

category: Error message codes of the "Port configuration"
description: The module does not support this protocol.
remedy: Select a valid protocol for the module.

description:
More than two end delimiters or
end sequence > 5 characters
remedy:
Select suitable values for "End delimiter" and "End sequence".
The following are valid:
deactivated (0),
1 (1) or 2 (2) end delimiters
or
deactivated (0),
1 (1) up to 5 (5) characters for the end sequence.

description: Send configuration rejected because the 3964(R) protocol was selected
remedy: Make sure that no send configuration is transmitted if the 3964(R) protocol is set.

description: Invalid start condition
remedy:
Select a suitable start condition.
The following are valid:
Send break before frame start
Send Idle Line.

description: Invalid end condition or no end condition selected
remedy: Select a suitable end condition (see Receiving data with Freeport (S7-1500)).

description: Invalid value for "Maximum message length"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Maximum message length" (MAXLEN).
Valid range of values (depending on the module): 1-1024/2048/4096 (Byte)

description: Invalid value for "Offset of the length specification in the message"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Offset of the length specification in the message".
Valid range of values (depending on the module): 1-1024/2048/4096 (Byte)

description: Invalid value for "Size of length field"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Size of length field" (LENGTHSIZE).
Valid range of values in bytes:
1 (1)
2 (2)
4 (4)

description: Invalid value for "Number of characters not counted in length specification"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Number of characters not counted in length specification" (LENGTHM).
Valid range of values: 0 to 255 (bytes)

description: The total of "Offset in the message + size of length field + number of characters not counted" is greater than the maximum frame length
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Offset in message", "Size of length field" and "Number of characters not counted".
Valid range of values:
Offset in the message (depending on the module):
0-1024/2048/4096 (bytes)
Size of length field: 1, 2, or 4 (bytes)
Number of characters not counted: 0 to 255 (bytes)

description: Invalid value for "Response timeout"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Response timeout".

description: Invalid value for "Character delay time"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Character delay time".
Valid range of values: 1 to 65535 (bit times)

description: frame end sequence is activated, but no character is activated for the check
remedy: Activate one or several characters for the check.

description: frame start sequence is activated, but no character is activated for the check
remedy: Activate one or several characters for the check.

description: Invalid value for "Prevent overwriting"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Prevent overwriting".
The following are valid:
Prevent overwriting is deactivated (0) or
Prevent overwriting is activated (1)

description: Invalid value for "Clear receive buffer on startup"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Clear receive buffer on startup".
The following are valid:
Clear receive buffer at startup is deactivated (0)
Clear receive buffer at startup is activated (1)

description: Receiving send request during runtime of a send command
remedy: Make sure that you do not receive an additional send request during runtime of a send command.

description: The waiting time for XON or CTS = ON has expired.
remedy: The communication partner has a fault, is too slow or is offline. Check the communication partner or change the parameters, if necessary.

description: "Hardware RTS always ON": Send job canceled due to change from DSR = ON to OFF
remedy: Check the communication partner. Make sure that DSR is ON for the entire duration of transmission.

description: Send buffer overflow / send frame too long
remedy:
Select a shorter frame length.
The following are valid (depending on the module): 1 to 1024/2048/4096 (bytes)

description: Transmission canceled due to parameter changes, detected wire break, or CPU in STOP
remedy: Check the parameter assignment, wire break, and CPU status.

description: Transmission canceled because end identifier was not received
remedy: Check the parameter assignment of the end characters and the frame of the communication partner.

description: Communication error between the user program and module
remedy: Check the communication (e.g., matching the sequence number).

description: Transmission attempt rejected because module is not configured
remedy: Configure the module.

remedy: Check the settings for start bit, data bits, parity bit, data transmission rate, and stop bit(s).

description: Parameter assignment error: Invalid value for "Response timeout".
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Response timeout" (AcknDelayTime).
Valid range of values: 1 to 65535 (ms)

description: Parameter assignment error: Invalid value for "Priority".
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Priority" (Priority).
The following are valid:
High (1)
Low (0)

description: Parameter assignment error: Invalid value for "Block check"
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Block check" (BCC).
The following are valid:
With block check (1)
Without block check (0)

description: Parameter assignment error: Invalid value for "Connection attempts".
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Connection attempts" (BuildupAttempts).
Valid range of values: 1-255

description: Parameter assignment error: Invalid value for "Transmission attempts".
remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Transmission attempts" (RepetitionAttempts).
Valid range of values: 1-255

description: Runtime error: Number of connection attempts exceeded
remedy:
Check the interface cable and the transmission parameters.
Also check whether the receive function is configured correctly at the partner device.

description: Runtime error: Number of transmission attempts exceeded
remedy: Check the interface cable, the transmission parameters and the configuration of the communication partner.

description:
Runtime error: Error at the "Block check character"
The internally calculated value of the block check character does not correspond to the block check character received by the partner at the connection end.
remedy: Check whether the connection is seriously disrupted; in this case you may also occasionally see error codes. Check for proper function at the partner device, possibly by using an interface test device that is switched into the transmission line.

description: Runtime error: Invalid character received while waiting for free receive buffer
remedy:
The send request of the communication partner (STX, 02H) is only answered with DLE when the receive buffer is empty. No additional character may be received before (except STX again).
Check for proper function at the partner device, possibly by using an interface test device that is switched into the transmission line.

description:
Runtime error: Logical error during receiving.
After DLE was received, a further random character (other than DLE or ETX) was received.
remedy: Check if partner DLE in frame header and in data string is always in duplicate or the connection is released with DLE ETX. Check for proper function at the partner device, possibly by using an interface test device that is switched into the transmission line.

description: Runtime error: Character delay time exceeded
remedy:
Partner device too slow or faulty.
Verify by using an interface test device that is switched into the transmission line, if necessary.

description: Runtime error: Wait time for free receive buffer has started
remedy: In the user program call the instruction more often or configure a communication with data flow control.

description: Runtime error: frame repetition does not start within 4 s after NAK
remedy: Check the communication partner. A received frame that is possibly corrupted must be repeated by the partner within 4 seconds.

description: Runtime error: In idle mode, one or several characters (other than NAK or STX) were received.
remedy: Check for proper function of the partner device, possibly using an interface test device that is switched into the transmission line.

description: Runtime error: Initialization conflict - Both partners have set high priority
remedy: Set the "Low" priority at one of the partners

description: Parameter assignment error: 3964 configuration data rejected because Freeport is set
remedy: If the Freeport protocol is set, make sure that no 3964 parameter assignment data is sent.

description: No error
Length error in response of drive
remedy: Check the response frame of the drive.

description: Data type error
remedy:
Select a suitable data type.
The following are valid:
Real
Word
Double word

description: Data type error: "Double word" or "Real" may not be returned for the "Word" request.
remedy: Check the response frame of the drive.

description: Data type error: "Word" may not be returned for the "Double word" or "Real" request.
remedy: Check the response frame of the drive.

description: Checksum error in response of drive
remedy: Check the drive and the communication connection.

description: Addressing error
remedy: Valid drive address range: 1 to 16

description: Setpoint error
remedy: Valid setpoint range: -200% to +200%

description: Incorrect drive number returned
remedy: Check the response frame of the drive.

description: Invalid PZD length
remedy: Permitted PZD lengths: 2, 4, 6, 8 words

description: The module does not support this data transmission rate.
remedy: Select a valid data transmission rate for the module.

description: A different request for this drive is currently active.
remedy: Repeat the parameter read or write command later.

description: The drive does not respond.
remedy: Check the drive.

description: The drive responds with an error message to a parameter request.
remedy:
Check the response frame of the drive.
Check the parameter request.
Check if the instructions USS_Read_Param, USS_Write_Param or USS_Port_Scan have reported an error. If they have, check the value of the static tag USS_DB. w_USSExtendedError of the USS_Drive_Control instruction.

description: The drive responds with an access error message to a parameter request.
remedy:
Check the response frame of the drive.
Check the parameter request.

description: The drive was not initialized.
remedy: Check the user program and make sure that the USS_Drive_Control instruction is called for this drive.

description: Negative acknowledgment when reading module
remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Port_Config.RDREC.STATUS, Send_Config.RDREC.STATUS , Receive_Config.RDREC.STATUS , Send_P2P.RDREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.RDREC.STATUS, and in the description of the SFB RDREC.

description: Negative acknowledgment when writing module
remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Port_Config.WRREC.STATUS, Send_Config.WRREC.STATUS , Receive_Config.WRREC.STATUS , Send_P2P.RDREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.RDREC.STATUS, and in the description of the SFB WRREC.
